purpose: Declarative contracts for read-only MCP tool discovery helpers.

tools.name: list_tool_families
tools.description: List the compact top-level MCP tool families instead of the full flat catalog. Use this first when you need to choose a tool family without loading every tool.

include_compatibility_note.description: Include a note that the flat catalog remains available for compatibility/debugging

tools.name: tool_family_tools
tools.description: List the tools that belong to one tool family. Use this after list_tool_families when you need the concrete tool names and arguments for one area.

depth.description: brief shows compact summaries; full includes input schemas

tools.name: tool_explain
tools.description: Explain a specific tool in task context. Use this when you know the tool name but want the shortest useful explanation, required arguments, and common pitfalls.

task_context.description: Optional task context used to tailor the explanation

tools.name: tool_recommend
tools.description: Recommend the next MCP family and tools for a task. Use this when you want the system to narrow a large toolset to the few best next calls.

project_id.description: Optional project id for project-aware recommendations
